preregistration.name: Proxima Milestone 9 frozen-detector temporal confirmation
preregistration.scientific_target: A narrowband transmitter stable in the planet frame and not necessarily aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: For each of 2021-04-29, 2021-04-30, and 2021-05-01, use the earliest complete 30-minute 2 Hz PROXCEN_S scan in the public archive and its immediately following complete 5-minute 1421-490_S control scan. Search the same 1405.25-1405.75 MHz planet-frame interval used in Milestone 8.
preregistration.confirmation_scope: Independent in observing epoch from Milestones 7 and 8, and acquired about two years later at 2 Hz rather than 3.814697 Hz resolution; not independent in frequency because it directly retests the Milestone 8 1405.25-1405.75 MHz interval.
preregistration.method_note: The Milestone 8 v0.4.0 recurrence statistic, S/N floor, moving per-epoch RFI mask, spectral widths, candidate clustering, family flags, orbital bank, and completeness procedure are copied without adjustment. Only the predeclared scans, one confirmation band, and random seeds differ.
preregistration.prior_data_contact: Archive table metadata and SIGPROC headers were inspected to verify source, completeness, cadence, resolution, and coverage. No spectral payload from these six files was extracted or inspected before this preregistration.
preregistration.control_cadence_limit: Each 30-minute ON scan is paired with the immediately following 5-minute 1421-490_S scan. OFF controls therefore have one-sixth the integration time and are less sensitive than the ON scans.
preregistration.data_release: Breakthrough Listen Parkes P1018_2 blc05 public filterbanks

global_result.assessment: NO CANDIDATE: every ON maximum is below the calibrated operational threshold.

window.selection_note: Direct temporal retest of the Milestone 8 lower confirmation interval with a 350 kHz extraction guard on each side.

spectral_leakage.model: rectangular FFT window; one-bin power statistic

acceleration_smearing_by_active_epoch.model: uniform power across bins traversed during one integration

diagnostics_for_on_best.important_note: The pipeline searches normalized multi-channel boxcars and measures their recovery with time-averaged sinc-squared injections. These analytic loss fields remain approximations.

completeness.method: Real m9_1405p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 1 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 0.5 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.

Confirmation scope: Independent in observing epoch from Milestones 7 and 8, and acquired about two years later at 2 Hz rather than 3.814697 Hz resolution; not independent in frequency because it directly retests the Milestone 8 1405.25-1405.75 MHz interval.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
